A SPECIFIC WORKED EXAMPLE

1 report

connecting the image, journey and operator action

Prepared scenario, not measured customer results.
THE INPUT

A carrier log shows a temperature excursion while the pallet image sits in a separate quality folder.

THE USEFUL OUTPUT

The prepared report connects the 35-minute excursion with the pallet that needs an inspection.

WHY THIS NEEDS SUBSTANTIAL AI PROCESSING

Real work creates
a recurring workload.

A shipment’s condition can change between collection and delivery. Images, door events and temperature histories must be reviewed repeatedly across many active loads.

Planning scenario · not current customer usageAt intake, during transport and at handover
633,600condition checks / month
158,400shipment checkpoints in this scenario
4images and records per check
55 organizations×120 active shipments per operator×24 checks per shipment / month×4 images and records per check

The same load is checked at multiple points. The value comes from combining visual condition with its changing storage and transport history.

HOW THE JOB GETS DONE

Four steps.
One useful decision.

The warning supports an inspection. It does not certify food safety or replace a qualified quality decision.

  1. 01

    Read the shipment

    Combine pallet images, route events and the temperature history.

  2. 02

    Check for change

    Look for visible deterioration and temperature excursions.

  3. 03

    Explain the warning

    Show the pallet, observation and relevant part of the journey.

  4. 04

    Choose the response

    An operator inspects, contacts the carrier and records the action.
